symbols.name: transpose
symbols.meaning: The transpose of the matrix $A$, whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ is $A_{ji}$.
symbols.quote: The *transpose* $A^{\top}$ of an $m\times m$ matrix $A$ is the $m\times m$ matrix whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ is $A_{ji}$, so its rows are the columns of $A$.

relations.quote: A symmetric matrix is a special case of the matrices in [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
